svg.text: Strawberry Crown-Rot Field Camera: two identical Arducam 64MP Hawkeye stations (4 inoculated plants each), UF/IFAS GCREC, Wimauma FL
rev. 5 · Nov 1, 2026 · from build plan rev. 3, the Oct 28 and Oct 31 Amazon lists, and the Oct 31 handoff · 96 in (8 ft) T-post from Home Depot · drawn for one station; build ×2
[O] ordered · [L1] Oct 28 list · [L2] Oct 31 list · [HD] Home Depot · [TB] still to buy

Camera software (set up on the bench, in the lab with internet)
Arducam driver fork (not the stock driver) · /boot/firmware/config.txt: dtoverlay=arducam-64mp (add ,cam0 if on CAM0) · usb_max_current_enable=1
EEPROM: POWER_OFF_ON_HALT=1 · pin the kernel + libcamera packages · clone the configured card to a backup card
Run one autofocus at the crown distance (~1.27 m), then lock focus so it never hunts between frames
(!) Arducam forum has Pi 5 probe-failure reports: bench-test detection and one full-resolution frame before anything goes outside

[O ×2] Redodo 12 V 50 Ah LiFePO4, 640 Wh, 50 A BMS: $185.99 ea · M8 terminal bolts (14 mm), insulating caps included

[L1] Anyongora 12 AWG waterproof inline ATC fuse holder: $7.99/4 · 5 A blade near battery + (load ≈ 0.4 A)
[O ×2] DROK 8–100 V 20 A meter, built-in shunt: $16.99 ea · after the fuse; wire it per its own diagram
(!) DROK location still open: build plan + this diagram = battery box; earlier handoff = camera box, LCD facing the lid.
Also check its temperature rating and whether the Wh count survives a power loss.
[L2] Kuject 260 pc: 5/16 in rings (yellow = 12 AWG fuse leads, blue = 16 AWG riser), heat-shrink butt splices: $17.99
[L2] XHF 16 AWG 2-conductor 30 ft: $19.99 · riser ≈ 12 ft per station (2.5 ft to post + 5.5 ft up + 3 ft arm + loop),
so one spool should cover both (estimate; check whether lever connectors come with it)
Fit check: 6.2 in spare length beside the battery for fuse + meter; 3.7 in headroom above terminals

(d) Power and data flow, daily schedule, energy and storage (per station)
battery box ← 12–13.4 V → camera box · 5.0 V over USB-C inside the camera box
or swap the card at battery swap
DAILY SCHEDULE · Nov 1, 2026 (EST; DST ended today) · sunrise 6:40, sunset 5:46 PM
6:10 RTC alarm wakes the Pi (sunrise − 30 min)
5:46 PM sunset: set tomorrow's alarm, halt
ENERGY (estimates; verify with a 24 h DROK log)
Daylight only: ≈ 55–65 Wh/day → ≈ 10 days per 640 Wh
Swap or recharge within 7 days; sooner if the DROK
(!) without POWER_OFF_ON_HALT=1 a "halted" Pi 5 drew 1.7 W
512 GB card ≈ 4–10 weeks; measure file size on day 1
Copy or swap the card at each battery swap
Files named by the Pi's RTC clock; compute sunrise
in code (e.g. astral), not fixed times
Tip: keep the RTC and file names in UTC so DST
changes can't duplicate or skip an hour of names
capture.py still needs the rewrite (untested on hardware):
9152 × 6944 JPEG at 1 frame/min · sunrise wake via /sys/class/rtc/rtc0/wakealarm · halt at dusk · RTC-stamped names
Bench test Tue Nov 3 needs: Pi 5, Hawkeye, card, buck, DROK and a charged battery

Geometry reference (lens = post top − 151 mm; crowns on a 10 in bed; Hawkeye 72° × 54.6°, 9152 × 6944 px; long axis along the row)
8 ft driven 2.5 ft (chosen): top 5.5 ft, lens 5.0 ft, 1.27 m to crowns → 1.85 × 1.31 m, 0.20 mm/px · 4-plant block (30–32 in at 18 in canopies) keeps ≈ 10 in margin each side

8 ft driven 2 ft: top 6.0 ft, lens 5.5 ft, 1.42 m → 2.06 × 1.47 m, 0.23 mm/px · 7 ft driven 2 ft: lens 4.5 ft, 1.12 m → 1.63 × 1.16 m, 0.18 mm/px · 6-1/2 ft driven 2 ft: lens 4.0 ft, 0.97 m → 1.41 × 1.00 m, 0.15 mm/px
Arm: cut the 4 ft strut to D + ~6 in after measuring D (post to bed centre line) on site; the bed photo estimate (≈ 30 in bed, 26–35 in) gives an arm of ≈ 25–35 in.
Holes (NEIKO #5): PG7 → 1/2 in · PG9 → 5/8 in · PG11 → 3/4 in · M12 vent → 1/2 in · camera window → 1-3/8 in. Glands and vent in side walls only; the base faces the sky.
Energy and storage figures are estimates from published Pi 5 measurements plus a camera allowance; replace them with the 24 h DROK log and the day-1 file size.
